description: If you want to go further as a family, the Singletrailer II Gravel is here to help. A comfortable and capable single-wheel child trailer, the Singletrailer II Gravel is ready for rides of any length over mixed types of terrain. The compact and efficient 20” wheel with adjustable suspension transitions from paved roads to gravel with ease, while the five-point adjustable harness, weatherproof cover, and reinforced rollover cage keep traveling passengers safe, happy, and secure.
